What we shoot

Five services, one crew — photography, film and design built around your brief, from first call to final export.

Portraits & Graduations

Studio and on-location portraits — graduation gowns, professional headshots, family sittings — lit and directed so the personality comes through, not just the pose.

Events & Corporate

Conferences, brand activations and bank launches covered discreetly and completely: candid moments, key handshakes, stage shots and the details sponsors need for their own reporting.

Fashion & Lifestyle

Editorial-style shoots for designers and creators who need a look book that reads like a magazine spread, not a catalogue scan.

Food & Catalogue

Menu and product photography for restaurants and hospitality brands, styled for the way people actually order — close, warm, appetite-first.

Video & Graphic Design

Short-form video, TV segment coverage and supporting graphic design, so the same visual language carries from screen to print to social.

Fotos By Don is a small creative studio in Gaborone, built around one idea — that a photograph should still feel true once the moment has passed.

Over five years, that's meant courtside seats at bank launches, backstage at graduations, quiet studio sittings and long dinners photographed course by course. The crew handles photography, videography, marketing content and graphic design, so a client can brief once and leave with a finished set — not a folder of raw files to sort through.

Every booking starts with a conversation about how the images will actually be used: on stage screens, in a annual report, on a menu, or simply printed and framed at home.
